extension.summary: Multi-Provider WireGuard VPN Manager (NordVPN, PIA, Custom, ProtonVPN)
extension.description: High-performance, hardened WireGuard VPN manager for LibreELEC. Supports multiple providers including NordVPN (NordLynx), Private Internet Access (PIA), ProtonVPN via Custom Mode, and Custom configurations. Features an automated Systemd watchdog to prevent connection drops.[CR][CR][B]Note:[/B] Designed specifically for LibreELEC. [CR][CR][B]Features:[/B][CR]• Multi-Provider Support (Nord, PIA, Custom)[CR]• Pure Python WireGuard Handshake logic[CR]• Smart Watchdog & Auto-Reconnect[CR]• Hardened DNS & IPv6 Leak Protection[CR][CR][B]Disclaimer:[/B] Not an official product of any VPN provider. Use at your own risk.
extension.news: v1.5.0 (2026-07-23) - Added: Zero-leak kernel-level Firewall Killswitch for IPv4 (nftables/iptables support) - Added: Smart Local Network (LAN) bypass ensuring local media shares (Samba/NFS) stay online when VPN drops - Added: Automated Zero-Hardcode infrastructure (Dynamic home subnet and server IP detection) - Added: Integrated Systemd runtime override configuration deploying '--nodnsproxy' to permanently halt ConnMan DNS file descriptor loops - Added: Automatic 'EnableOnlineCheck = false' injection to cleanly stop HTTP socket leaks on legacy LE 12 environments - Improved: Cleaned up background dependencies and optimized core network parsing speed - Improved: Subinterpreter-safe Python background garbage collector as a robust safety net for underlying network daemons
